title: BARRAGE x  x Kokushibo
features:
Combat & Farming
Auto Farm / Auto Boss Farm – Efficiently automate mob and boss encounters.

Kill Aura – Automatically attack nearby entities.

Auto Summon Boss – Trigger boss spawns instantly.

Pity Re-summon – Optimized summoning based on pity mechanics.

Auto Quest – Automated progression through questlines.

 

Game Modes


Auto Dungeon / Auto Boss Rush – Full automation for instance-based content.

Auto Infinite Tower – Climb the tower without manual input.

Auto-Start / Auto-Replay – Continuous looping of selected game modes.


Movement & Utility

Quick / NPC Teleport – Instant travel to key locations or characters.

Tween & Teleport Movement – Smooth or instant travel options.

Adjustable Speeds – Fully customizable movement pacing.


Follow Player – Stick to a specific target automatically.


Management & Progression

Skill Tree Automation – Automatically allocate points and upgrades.


Loadout Management – Save and swap gear sets instantly.

Auto Equip – Automatically use the best available items.

ShopBrowser / Live Stats – Real-time data and remote shopping access.


Customization & Upgrades

Auto Title / Auto Rune – Automated enhancement and cosmetic management.

Auto Accessory / Aura / Cosmetic – Keeps your character’s appearance and buffs updated.
